meta.title: Autonomous AI Coding Agent: Architectural Evolution & Benchmark Milestones
meta.subtitle: Progression across 5 development epochs from unmetered zero-shot LLM baseline to sovereign 4-pillar verification gate on the 50-task SWE benchmark.

views.label: Full Evolution
views.note: Complete 5-epoch progression from 24% baseline to 86% verified SWE pass rate.

views.label: Architecture Epochs
views.note: Evolution from monolithic prompt to 5 specialized LangGraph agents.

views.label: Verification Gates
views.note: Introduction of adversarial code review, AST assertion audit, and TOCTOU manifest checks.

views.label: Benchmark Runs
views.note: SWE-50 benchmark pass rate, regression interception, and McNemar statistical significance.

events.title: Epoch 1: Zero-Shot Baseline
events.detail: Monolithic prompt generating code and tests in a single unmetered call without runtime execution.

events.title: Baseline Benchmark: 24% Pass
events.detail: 12/50 tasks passed. 28 baseline test regressions observed; 14 silent test assertion modifications.

events.title: Epoch 2: LangGraph Core Loop
events.detail: StateGraph with isolated unified execution sandbox, AtomicPatcher AST pre-validation, and retry metering.

events.title: Single-Agent Loop: 48% Pass
events.detail: 24/50 tasks passed. Intercepted syntax crashes via AtomicPatcher, but silent regressions remained.

events.title: Epoch 3: 5 Specialized Agents
events.detail: Decomposed into Manager, Coder, TestGen, Reviewer, and Debugger governed by strict Pydantic contracts.

events.title: Adversarial Reviewer Active
events.detail: Automated code quality scoring (>= 8.0/10) and SHA-256 pre-flight production hash validation.

events.title: Multi-Agent: 68% Pass Rate
events.detail: 34/50 tasks passed. Baseline regressions dropped from 28 to 6; scope creep eliminated.

events.title: AST Assertion Auditor Deployed
events.detail: AST comparator actively detects deleted or weakened test assertions (e.g. assert True replacement).

events.title: Epoch 4: AST Self-Healing Debugger
events.detail: Debugger generates AST-targeted traceback diagnostics, routing directly into Coder remediation.

events.title: Sovereign 4-Pillar Gate & WAL
events.detail: Decoupled verifier enforces out-of-band baseline ledger, TOCTOU manifest check, and sealed tar.gz.

events.title: SWE-50 Final: 86% Verified Pass
events.detail: 43/50 tasks verified. 0 regressions (100% intercepted). McNemar paired test p < 0.0001.

cards.title: Epoch 1: Zero-Shot Baseline (24%)
items: Monolithic LLM prompt with no execution feedback
Silent modifications to test assertions undetected

cards.title: Epoch 2: Single-Agent Loop (48%)
items: LangGraph StateGraph with isolated pytest sandbox
AtomicPatcher AST pre-validation prevents syntax corruption
Centralized retry metering prevents infinite runaway loops

cards.title: Epoch 3: 5 Specialized Agents (68%)
items: Separation of concerns: Manager, Coder, TestGen, Reviewer, Debugger
Adversarial test generation without Coder's shortcuts
Regressions drop from 28 down to 6 tasks

cards.title: Epoch 4: AST Self-Healing Debugger (82%)
items: AST traceback analysis isolates exact failure frames
Targeted remediation plans eliminate guess-and-check cycles
Average iterations to green reduced from 3.8 to 1.6

cards.title: Epoch 5: Sovereign 4-Pillar Verification (86%)
items: Decoupled verifier with out-of-band SHA-256 baseline ledger
Zero regressions accepted across all 50 tasks (100% interception)
Statistically proven superior to baseline (McNemar p < 0.0001)
